site.title: Faster Finder
site.intro: Searches your drives, or the folder you choose, for photo and video folders (DCIM, Camera, Videos…), and lets you open them with a double click.
site.version: Version __VERSION__. Open it and you're done: it needs no Python and no administrator rights. It updates itself from this page.
site.step1: Download the installer and open it.
site.step2: Wait for it to finish: it sets up its own Python and creates shortcuts in the Start menu and on the desktop.
site.step3: To remove it, use Windows "Installed apps".
site.js.title: Faster Finder · find your photos and videos on Windows
